//: What Orbit lends to add-ons it downloads: each key is the name a downloaded add-on asks for, and each value is the module it gets. They share these with Orbit (one React, one pet, one mini games store) rather than bringing their own copies. scripts/build-addon.mjs reads this, and lib/addonHost.ts provides them. Changing what one of these exports means building the add-ons again.
